findings.claim: R4 is not closed: §d4's replacement figure ($4.2252 / 86.7x) still does not re-derive from §d1's own cost model and the §c1 census, and the per-document number it quotes for reac-2015 is wrong by 3x and is not the smallest of the twelve.
findings.evidence: ADR-036:373 publishes '$4.2252 per dev sweep ... 86.7x'; :379 'the smallest is reac-2015 at $0.0370'. Applying §d4's OWN stated model over exactly the twelve documents it names, with char counts from d11_trigger_scan.py, gives a sweep of $4.5656 = 93.6x. The same model reproduces every §d1 figure to the published digit ($0.0488 / $0.1373 / $0.8914 / $1.5257) and every per-document figure §d4 itself quotes, so the model is not in dispute — only the total. reac-2015 prices at $0.1087, not $0.0370; the smallest of the twelve is xref-index-collapse at $0.0488. No committed script re-derives §d4. Separately ADR-036:723's falsifier table still cites '§d4's $3.4/sweep' — the figure §d4 itself now declares wrong.
findings.repro: apply §d4's stated formula to the twelve named documents -> 4.5656, ratio 93.6 (xref ladder 0.04875375)
findings.acceptance: §d4's sweep total, its ratio, and every per-document figure it quotes re-derive from §d1's model and the census — ideally from a committed script the way §c1 has d11_trigger_scan.py — and §l's A2 row cites the corrected figure instead of $3.4.

findings.claim: The two money locks added for R6 are invisible to the gate and to both CI self-checks: replacing the arming constant with True and the process budget with an effectively infinite one leaves invariant 76/76, fast 139/139 and both _demos green — the exact R3 failure mode, reintroduced on the credential-facing code.
findings.evidence: web/app.py:80 ESCALATION_ENABLED = os.environ.get('SEC10K_ESCALATION_ENABLED') == '1' and ~:93 _SERVER_BUDGET = Budget(...). The only checks over this code are two source-text pins in repo_hygiene WIRE_API, and both survive a mutation of the constant's definition and the budget's construction because neither pin reads them. app.py imports fastapi so it has no CI self-check, and ci.yml's new lines only run src.sec10k.escalate and src.sec10k.llm. Result: with a real key on the public host, one edit no gate can see re-arms unbounded paid work.
findings.repro: In a copy: ESCALATION_ENABLED = True and Budget(max_calls=10**9, max_usd=10.0**9) -> invariant 76/76, fast 139/139, both _demos ok
findings.acceptance: A runnable check binds both locks — e.g. a repo_hygiene check asserting the arming expression is an equality against the env var (not a constant) and that the process Budget is built from the two env-var constants, or a fastapi-free _run-level self-check — and re-running the two mutations turns the gate or a CI job red.

findings.claim: ADR-036 still publishes the dropped reasoning-effort knob as a live ruling and as part of the cache key, contradicting §h1's claim in the same document that it is 'gone and its plumbing with it'.

findings.claim: §h2 presents SEC10K_ESCALATION_MAX_USD (default $5.00) as the deployment's spend bound without carrying §d3's overshoot disclosure, and on an attacker-chosen 25 MB upload that overshoot is roughly the ceiling again, so the true bound is ~$10, not $5.
findings.evidence: llm.py:150-160 Budget.take refuses only when spent >= max_usd, i.e. after the fact; the ponytail comment quantifies the overshoot with the DEV worst case (jpm-2024 $1.52 vs $1.00). On the deployment the document is attacker-supplied and capped only by MAX_BYTES = 25MB (app.py:38); escalate.route sends the WHOLE document to rung 2 (shown, offset = text, 0 — escalate.py:302) with no input cap. A ~4M-char upload is ~1M input tokens at $5.00/MTok = one ~$5.00 call taken at spent=$4.99. §h2 names $5.00, says 'the locks bound spend', and never restates §d3; the TODO debt row still quotes the $1.52 dev worst case, which does not bound this input.
findings.repro: grep -n 'spent >= self.max_usd' src/sec10k/llm.py; sed -n '300,303p' src/sec10k/escalate.py; §h2 grep -c overshoot -> 0
findings.acceptance: Either rung 2's input is capped (as rung 1's is by LOCALIZE_WINDOW) so a single call's price is bounded on arbitrary uploads, or §h2 states the effective deployment ceiling as MAX_USD plus one call's own price and the debt row's worst case is restated for a 25 MB upload.
